claims.claim: The workflow requires clean attached main with exactly one origin/main upstream, validates canonical fetch/push URLs, and binds an immutable fetched control SHA before Runtime continuation.

Exact RUN/decision selectors and origin authority remain intact. Existing Runtime source eligibility, live-main rechecks, reservations and CAS remain unchanged; checkout alignment permits only fast-forward.

Local regressions reproduce the detached-upstream failure and reach existing recovery eligibility with attached control. Stale selectors, TASK changes, overlap and competing PASS retain specific Runtime blockers without publication.
Chat delivery uses the existing independent completed-workflow listener. Publisher retains bounded attention artifacts and separately reports Runtime outcomes, including AWAITING_REVIEW.

Added deterministic temporary-Git regressions covering detached failure, attached success, upstream ambiguity, origin substitution, stale main, replay, missing or changed TASK, and pending or divergent competing PASS.
The committed change touches only the three authorized files, preserves Runtime review/publication authority, and performs no live RUN-349-001 publication or lineage mutation.
